content.rendered:
See the NEW densimetric table in action, processing 18 tph of dirty compost from MSW and producing 15 tph of clean compost and 3 tph of clean inerts.

See the new densimetric table from Van Dyk Recycling Solutions in action. This densimetric table processes 18 tph of dirty compost from MSW, producing 15 tph of clean compost and 3 tph of clean inerts (glass, stone and metals).
